name: taskDescription
label: Learner instructions
default: Click the character after which a space or mark is needed. In the created input field you can type the mark from the keyboard or add it using a mark button above the text.

name: removableSymbols
label: List of symbols to remove and require for restoration
description: Default: space, comma, full stop, colon, semicolon, question mark, exclamation mark and em dash. Spaces are removed and required in the relevant exercise modes even if the invisible leading space is omitted from this list during editing. If the list contains an em dash, hyphen and dash answers are treated as equivalent. A standalone hyphen in the author text is treated as a dash. Apostrophe ' and its typographic variants ’, ʼ, ′ are treated as equivalent when checking.

fields.name: instruction
fields.label: Answer area instruction
fields.description: Leave empty if no separate instruction should be shown above this sentence's answer area. Each sentence may have a different instruction.

fields.name: sentence
fields.label: Linguistically correct sentence
fields.placeholder: Enter the sentence with spaces and marks.
fields.description: Enter one linguistically correct sentence. Text copied from a web page is cleaned of HTML entities in learner view.

default.sentence: Hello, world! Can you add spaces?

fields.name: showCorrectTextAfterCheck
fields.label: Show the correct sentence after checking

fields.name: showPunctuationButtons
fields.label: Show mark buttons in learner view
fields.description: When enabled, the learner can also insert the marks included in the list of removed symbols using buttons above the text. The space character is not shown as a button.

fields.name: correctFeedback
fields.label: Feedback for a completely correct answer

fields.name: gapLabel
fields.label: Input field accessibility label
fields.default: Type the missing mark or space here

fields.name: emptyContent
fields.label: Empty content message
fields.default: The author has not added any sentences.

fields.name: insertSpaceAfterLetter
fields.label: Character click accessibility label
fields.default: Add an input field after this character

fields.name: punctuationButtonLabel
fields.label: Mark button accessibility label
fields.description: The variable @symbol is replaced with the corresponding mark.

fields.name: rewriteHint
fields.label: Hint about correcting already inserted marks
fields.default: * Do not correct already inserted marks; instead, delete them and then type them again.
